established: Complete ApplyDamageBonuses adds the existing skill roll to the independently enhanced/rolled current weapon, then scales their sum96/128. Complete FillDamageValues doubles that physical result once in mastery/generic/deadly order.

Each current weapon typed endpoint is mastery-enhanced and rolled before96/128 scaling. Poison rate scales while its source count/override length remains independent; ordinary player leech percentages remain unscaled.

Current result flag32 suppresses the attacked-in-melee callback in complete FillDamageValues. Complete ExecuteEvents is separately reviewed, not compiled here: its successful weapon and kill callback blocks also require flag32 absent.
limits: Stat composition, selected weapon, physical skill roll, class/species and RNG are explicit fixtures. No claim of whole current executable equivalence.
Full mitigation, block/hit result, actual native delivery, item registration, durability and complete ExecuteEvents are separate boundaries.
Conversion, monster/hireling attacker, nonzero normal-damage stat, independent min/max percentages, stat damage-vs-montype and stun source lanes are compiled but not covered by this player matrix.
